privacy.title: Privacy Policy
short: Prexpire works without an account. Your items, lists and settings are stored on your phone.
Labels and dates are read on your phone. Camera images are never uploaded or kept.
When a barcode is scanned, only its number is sent to product databases to find the product's name.

If you create an account, we keep your email and a copy of your items so you can back them up and use them on another phone. You can delete the account at any time in the app or at app.prexpire.com/delete-account.
No ads, no tracking, and we never sell or share your data for marketing.

sections.title: Who we are
body: Prexpire is an app for keeping track of the expiry dates of products at home. It's made and run by an individual developer living in Romania ("we", "us"), who is the controller of the personal data described here.
Questions about this policy or your data: support@prexpire.com.

sections.title: What stays on your phone
body: Everything you add to Prexpire is stored on your phone: products, expiry dates, categories, your shopping list, waste stats and settings. The app works fully offline and doesn't need an account.

The camera is used only while you scan. The images are read on the phone (with Apple's on-device text recognition and an on-device reader) to find barcodes and dates. They are not uploaded, saved or shared.

Reminders are worked out and scheduled on your phone, including the earlier reminders for categories you often throw away, which use your waste stats on the phone. Home Screen widgets read a copy of your upcoming items from a folder shared between the app and its widgets, which also stays on your phone.
Backups you export from Settings are files you save where you choose. We don't receive them.

sections.title: What leaves your phone, and why

list: Barcode lookups: to fill in a product's name, the barcode number is sent to public product databases (Open Food Facts, UPCitemdb, Go-UPC, barcodestock, Open Library for books, and a DuckDuckGo search as a fallback). Only the number is sent, never your other data.

App updates: the app checks app.prexpire.com for a newer version of its screens, and the App Store for a newer version of the app. These requests contain no personal data, though the servers see your IP address, like any connection.
Product photos: when a database has a photo of a scanned product, the app downloads it from that database's server.
Account and backup, only if you create an account (see below).

Security checks: when you sign in or create an account, a Cloudflare Turnstile check runs to stop automated abuse. Cloudflare processes technical data such as your IP address and browser details for this.
Purchases, only if you buy Prexpire Pro (see Prexpire Pro below).
Messages you send us from Help & Support, Send feedback or prexpire.com/support (see Messages to us below).

sections.title: Accounts and backup
body: An account is optional. If you create one, we process:

list: your email address, and your password, which is stored only in hashed form by our account provider;
if you use Sign in with Apple or Google: the identifier and email address they share with us (with Apple you can choose to hide your email);
a copy of your items, shopping list, categories, settings and waste stats, so they're backed up and the same on every phone you sign in on;
technical records our providers keep to run and secure the service, such as sign-in times and IP addresses.

body: We use this only to provide the account, backup and sync, and to send you the codes needed to confirm your email, sign in or reset your password. We don't read your items for any other purpose.

sections.title: Prexpire Pro
body: Purchases are made through Apple, so we never see your payment details. We use RevenueCat to check what you've bought and to keep Pro working on your devices. RevenueCat receives a random user ID (linked to your Prexpire account if you're signed in), your purchase and subscription history, and technical details such as the app version and your device's country and language.

sections.title: Messages to us
body: When you send a question, bug report, feedback or idea, we store the message, the type you chose, your email if you give one, the app version and platform, the country of your connection and a scrambled (hashed) form of your IP address, which we use only to limit abuse. Messages are stored with Cloudflare and emailed to us through Resend, so we can read and answer them.

sections.title: The website and the waitlist
body: prexpire.com doesn't use advertising or analytics cookies. If you join the waitlist, we store your email address, the time you joined, the page section you used and your country (derived from the connection), only to email you when Prexpire is available on the App Store.
After you join, the page may show your Gravatar picture to you. Your own browser requests it from Gravatar using a fingerprint (hash) of your email; nobody else sees it.
Our website doesn't track you across sites, so it responds the same way to "Do Not Track" signals as to any other visit.

sections.title: Service providers
body: We use these providers to run Prexpire. They process data only on our instructions:

list: Supabase: accounts, backup and sync (servers in the EU).
Resend: sending account emails such as confirmation and sign-in codes, and delivering your messages to us (EU, Ireland).
Cloudflare: the website, the waitlist, the Turnstile security check, storing your messages to us, and our domain.
Railway: hosting the files the app loads its screens from.
RevenueCat: checking Prexpire Pro purchases and subscriptions (United States).
Apple and Google: Sign in with Apple and Sign in with Google, when you choose them.
The product databases listed above, which receive barcode numbers only.

sections.title: Legal bases
body: Under the GDPR we rely on: performance of a contract, to provide your account, backup and sync, and Prexpire Pro; your consent, for the waitlist (you can withdraw it at any time); and our legitimate interests, to keep the service secure and prevent abuse, to look up product names when you scan, and to read and answer the messages you send us.

We don't make decisions about you by automated means that have legal or similarly significant effects. The earlier reminders based on your waste stats are worked out on your phone and only change when you're reminded.

list: Data on your phone stays until you delete it or remove the app.

Your account and its backup are kept until you delete the account. When you delete it (in the app or at app.prexpire.com/delete-account), you are signed out and it is deleted for good, with its backup, 30 days later. Until then you can restore it by signing back in. Copies in our providers' routine backups are overwritten within their normal cycle.
Purchase records are kept by RevenueCat for as long as you have an account or a purchase with us, and as Apple's and tax rules require.
Messages to us are kept for up to 2 years after we last replied, then deleted, or earlier if you ask.
Waitlist emails are kept until we've sent the launch email, then deleted, or earlier if you ask.
Security and server logs are kept only for the short periods our providers set.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You have the right to access your data, correct it, delete it, receive a copy in a portable format, restrict or object to its processing, and withdraw consent. You can delete your account yourself in Settings, Account, Delete account, or at app.prexpire.com/delete-account. For anything else, email support@prexpire.com and we'll reply within one month.
You can also complain to a data protection authority: in Romania, the ANSPDCP (dataprotection.ro), or the authority where you live.

sections.title: International transfers
body: Some providers, such as RevenueCat, Cloudflare, Railway, Apple and Google, may process data outside the EU, including in the United States. Where they do, the transfer is covered by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses.

sections.title: Security
body: Connections are encrypted (HTTPS). Each account's backup can be read only by that account, enforced in the database. Passwords are never stored in readable form. No system is perfectly secure, but we take reasonable measures to protect your data and will inform you and the authorities of a breach where the law requires it.

sections.title: Age
body: You can use Prexpire without an account at any age. To create an account you must be at least 16 years old.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: If this policy changes, we'll update the date at the top. For important changes, we'll tell you in the app or by email before they apply.

sections.title: Contact
body: support@prexpire.com

terms.title: Terms of Use
short: Prexpire helps you keep track of expiry dates. It's free with 20 new items a month, with or without an account; Prexpire Pro removes the limits.
Dates read by the scanner can be wrong. Always check the date printed on the pack before you eat, drink or use something.
Prexpire isn't food-safety, medical or pharmaceutical advice.
Your items are yours. You can delete your account and data at any time.

sections.title: Agreement
body: These terms apply to the Prexpire app and prexpire.com, provided by an individual developer living in Romania ("we", "us"). By using Prexpire you agree to them. If you don't agree, don't use the app.

sections.title: What Prexpire is
body: Prexpire lets you record products and their expiry dates, sorts them by what expires first, reminds you with notifications on your iPhone, shows what's next on Home Screen widgets, and keeps a shopping list. You can add products by scanning or by hand. An optional account backs up your data and keeps it the same across your phones.

sections.title: Check the date on the pack
body: The scanner and product lookups are helpful but not perfect: a date can be misread, and product databases can be incomplete or wrong. Before saving, check what Prexpire read, and before eating, drinking or using something, check the date and condition of the product itself.

Prexpire doesn't give food-safety, medical or pharmaceutical advice. Follow the instructions on the packaging and, for medicine, your pharmacist or doctor. Reminders depend on your phone: they don't arrive if notifications are turned off, the app is deleted, or the phone is off, and the app keeps only the next few weeks of them scheduled until you open it again. Don't rely on them alone for anything important.

sections.title: Your account
body: An account is optional. To create one you must be at least 16 and give an email address you can access. Keep your password private; you're responsible for what happens in your account. You can delete it at any time in Settings, Account, Delete account, or at app.prexpire.com/delete-account; it is deleted for good 30 days later, and until then signing back in lets you restore it.

sections.title: Your content
body: What you add to Prexpire stays yours. If you have an account, you allow us to store and copy it only as needed to back it up and sync it to your phones.

sections.title: Acceptable use

list: Don't try to access other people's accounts or data, or our systems beyond what the app offers.
Don't disrupt, overload or reverse-engineer the service, or get around its security checks.
Don't use Prexpire for anything unlawful.

body: We may suspend accounts that break these rules.

sections.title: Availability and changes
body: The app works offline, but backup, sync, barcode lookups and sign-in need an internet connection and our providers. We work to keep them running but can't promise they'll always be available. We may change or discontinue features; if we stop the account service, we'll give reasonable notice so you can keep your data, which also stays on your phone.

sections.title: Third-party services
body: Product names come from third-party databases, and sign-in can use Apple or Google. Their own terms apply to them, and we aren't responsible for their content or availability.

sections.title: Intellectual property
body: The app, its design and the Prexpire name and logo belong to us. You may use the app for your own personal use; don't copy, resell or redistribute it.

sections.title: Liability
body: Prexpire is provided as it is. To the extent the law allows, we aren't liable for losses caused by relying on dates or information shown in the app, for spoiled or wasted products, or for interruptions of the service. Nothing in these terms limits liability that can't be limited by law, such as for intent or gross negligence, or takes away your rights as a consumer.

sections.title: Prexpire Pro
body: Prexpire is free to use with 20 new items each calendar month and 1 category of your own. The count starts again on the 1st of each month; items you use up or delete don't give their place back. Prexpire Pro removes those limits. Everything else in the app stays free.

list: Pro is sold in the iPhone app through Apple, as a monthly or yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. Prices are shown in the app before you buy, in your local currency. The lifetime purchase can be shared with up to 5 family members through Apple Family Sharing; subscriptions can't.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. A free trial, when offered, turns into a paid subscription at its end unless you cancel at least 24 hours before.

Subscriptions renew automatically at the same price and length unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Cancel or manage them in your Apple ID settings (Settings, your name, Subscriptions) or in Prexpire, Settings, Prexpire Pro.
Refunds are handled by Apple under its policies (reportaproblem.apple.com).

If you're signed in, Pro belongs to your Prexpire account and works on your other iPhone or iPad signed in to it. If you stop paying, nothing is deleted: everything you added stays and keeps working, and the free monthly limit applies again to new items.

sections.title: Apple App Store
body: If you got Prexpire from the App Store, Apple's standard licence terms also apply. These terms are between you and us, not Apple; Apple isn't responsible for the app or its support, and has no obligation to maintain it.

sections.title: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of Romania. If you live in the EU, EEA, UK or Switzerland, you also keep the protection of the mandatory consumer laws of your country, and you can bring a claim in your local courts.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
body: If these terms change, we'll update the date at the top. For important changes, we'll tell you in the app or by email before they apply. If you keep using Prexpire afterwards, the new terms apply.
